en: Colorized historic postcard view of two grand multi‑story hotels or villas in a landscaped park. The buildings are ornate with towers, domes, balconies, and red roofs, and are labeled on the façades. Well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along paths and gather near an automobile and a decorative fountain. Statues and lush greenery surround the scene. Red printed German text at the top reads the location and names of the buildings.
